summary: American Airlines filed an 8-K reporting entry into the Twelfth Amendment to its Amended and Restated Credit and Guaranty Agreement. The amendment refinances existing term loans with $1,146.8 million in 2026 Refinancing Term Loans and adds $703.2 million in 2026 Incremental Term Loans, totaling $1,850.0 million. The loans bear interest at Base Rate plus 2.00% or SOFR plus 3.00%, maturing May 29, 2033. This is a routine refinancing and incurrence of debt, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. There is no change of control, shareholder return, or strategic review involved. The filing solely modifies existing credit facilities without triggering a special situation classification.
